overlap_firewalls.route: Method qualification owns error/power properties on declared worlds; ObservationSupport owns whether realized measurement preserves the support needed to instantiate that qualified procedure.
Deployment adequacy is prospective geometry detectability; ObservationSupport is realized post-measurement admissibility on the frozen units.
ObservationSupport can terminate a workflow as not_evaluable before the empirical statistic exists; CED owns reliability-qualified reporting once an evidence state exists under its declared contract.

ObservationSupport is a generic admission gate for whether a predeclared inferential design remains instantiable after measurement; REC specifically owns biological opportunity loss before row entry and estimand shift.
Boundary owns structural target identification; CED owns reliability-qualified terminal stopping/reportability.
MROD owns prospective observation value and sequential acquisition; CED owns the false-resolution-constrained terminal decision.
TNOA owns observation-level semantic preservation and local claim licensing; CED owns scientific-target licensing under the declared aggregate evidence/reliability contract.
V3 applies retained-information refinement; Boundary characterizes the current identification geometry after that refinement.
V3 uses an already-retained channel; MROD chooses a not-yet-realized future channel. The realized MROD observation becomes V3-style refinement.
CREST owns general contract-relative state theory; EGWE-state owns eco-genetic domain tests of forecast-relevant representation.
EGWEE owns natural-data gate outcomes; theouni may abstract an empirical admission contract but does not own those outcomes.
